<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Reaction Time</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0b132b;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0b132bee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;width:min(90vw,340px)}
button{background:#22c55e;color:#032b12;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700}button:disabled{background:#26345c;color:#7b88b0}
</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=20,K='mg_reaction',T='⚡ Reaction Time',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Chạm ngay khi màn hình chuyển xanh. Chạm sớm hoặc chạm lúc màu đỏ sẽ mất tim ❤️':'Click (hoặc Space/Enter) ngay khi màn hình chuyển xanh. Bấm sớm hoặc bấm lúc màu đỏ sẽ mất tim ❤️';
let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w,t){if(!run)return;draw();run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);lt=t;if(run){upd(d);if(run)draw()}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
let ph,tm,t0,ok,lf,need,thr,msg,dec,dp;
function init(){need=3+Math.ceil(lv/5);thr=520-lv*13;ok=0;lf=3;dp=lv<6?0:Math.min(.1+(lv-6)*.03,.4);nx()}
function nx(){ph=0;tm=1+Math.random()*2.5;msg='Chờ màn hình xanh...';dec=Math.random()<dp}
function res(t,bad){if(bad)lf--;msg=t;ph=3;tm=.9}
function upd(d){tm-=d;if(tm>0)return;if(ph==0){if(dec){ph=2;tm=.8+Math.random()*.6;msg='ĐỎ! Đừng bấm'}else{ph=1;t0=performance.now();tm=2;msg='BẤM!'}}else if(ph==2)nx();else if(ph==1)res('Quá chậm!',1);else if(ok>=need)end(1);else if(lf<=0)end(0);else nx()}
function press(){if(!run)return;if(ph==0)res('Bấm sớm quá!',1);else if(ph==2)res('Đó là màu đỏ!',1);else if(ph==1){const t=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);if(t<=thr){ok++;res(t+' ms ✅')}else res(t+' ms, chậm hơn '+thr+' ms',1)}}
function draw(){C.fillStyle=['#1e3a8a','#16a34a','#dc2626','#334155'][ph];C.fillRect(0,0,W,H);C.fillStyle='#fff';C.textAlign='center';C.textBaseline='middle';const f=Math.min(W/9,64);C.font='bold '+f+'px system-ui';C.fillText(msg,W/2,H/2,W-20);C.font=Math.min(W/20,20)+'px system-ui';C.fillText(`Đạt ${ok}/${need} · ❤️ ${lf} · Mục tiêu ≤ ${thr} ms`,W/2,H/2+f,W-20);h.textContent='Màn '+lv}
c.onpointerdown=press;onkeydown=e=>{if((e.key==' '||e.key=='Enter')&&!e.repeat){e.preventDefault();press()}};
menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
